answer: A relic found on the wrong island voids its identity at settlement. Each identity deposits one relic on its own island at registration, backed by a 400,000 POA bond, and a raven courier records every relic's mark once per epoch. Two marks matching across islands belong to one operator: both rewards burn, both bonds pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 258,000 POA fine per fake. One fake costs 658,000 POA, and five fakes cost 3,290,000 POA before any payout clears.
